summary: Shutter/Reveal.tsx: removed the unused justification state and its two TODOs, and omitted justification from the useRevealVote params so resolveRevealInputs falls back to the stored commit-time text. Also replaced isUndefined (src/utils) with an inline undefined/null check, because vitest cannot load src/utils: @kleros/kleros-app has only a 'module' field and vitest uses mainFields: [], and vitest transforms even factory-mocked modules. New Reveal.test.tsx (first .test.tsx) renders Reveal with module-level mocks. It asserts that the params for Shutter and GatedShutter carry no justification, and that those params plus a stored record {salt, choice, justification: 'stored text'} resolve through the real resolveRevealInputs to 'stored text'. All 3 tests fail when justification: "" is restored. resolveRevealInputs.test.ts gains 2 cases: the exact Reveal params with a stored record resolve to 'stored text', and an explicit non-empty justification wins over a stored one. Setup ran: web-setup.sh install/build/codegen all exit 0. Checks run: check-types exit 0, check-style exit 0 (after eslint --fix formatting on my files), test exit 0 (19 files, 176 tests). Existing tests unchanged. Nothing committed.
open_assumptions: Reveal.tsx no longer imports isUndefined from src/utils; it uses an inline `=== undefined || === null` check (same semantics) so the component can be loaded in vitest. This goes slightly beyond the decisions.md fix description but stays in the owned file.

The 'no stored record -> salt regenerated, choice brute-forced, empty justification' acceptance item is covered by the existing resolveRevealInputs.test.ts cases (per decisions.md); no new test was added for it.
Added one extra resolveRevealInputs case (explicit non-empty justification beats a stored non-empty one), because the existing case only covered a stored undefined justification.
